PROGRESS NOTE

The patient returns for annual surveillance after surgical aortic valve replacement placed
several years ago. No chest pain, dyspnea, or syncope is reported.

History: Operative records indicate a #21 mm Magna valve was implanted at that time.

Today's Echocardiogram: The Magna valve leaflets move well with no significant thickening.
The mean gradient is 11 mmHg, stable compared to prior surveillance studies, with no more
than trivial regurgitation.

Assessment: Normally functioning surgical bioprosthesis.
Plan: Continue routine annual surveillance echocardiography.
